evidence.note: Oracle's disclosure supports the 200MW capacity component. Its simultaneous schedule assertion disputes delay but supplies no baseline that resolves it.
The announced plan links two buildings to 200+MW and supplies milestone definitions. The mid-2026 completion target had not passed in April.
Crusoe reports timely first-phase energization, weakening an alleged missed 2025 milestone. It does not resolve the applicable April delivery schedule.

They do not establish an applicable missed April milestone or reconcile possible schedule revisions. The delay allegation remains unsettled; a future completion target cannot establish an April failure.

contract.note: Separating arithmetic from the explicitly claimed gross-margin metric is fair. Level monthly amortization is a reasonable interpretation of the stated loan payments.

evidence.note: The attached evaluator calculation supports 5.19% using rounded inputs, or 5.15% before rounding. The speaker's text supplies assumptions only; this does not validate the gross-margin label.

The attached reconciliation reproduces the payments and roughly -40% residual, but exposes depreciation combined with full debt service. Excluding depreciation yields an 8.87% cash residual before other uses.
The accounting guidance distinguishes loan repayment from income-statement profit and explains adding back depreciation in cash-flow reconciliation. It does not independently measure this model.

reviews.rationale: The rounded first-year percentage, monthly payments and approximately -40% arithmetic are reproducible. Their description as gross margins fails: the first-year calculation includes interest, while the later calculation combines depreciation with principal repayment. The numerical residuals hold under his method; the accounting interpretation does not.

contract.note: Verified new mathematical constructions are an ordinary test of substantive novelty. The speaker supplies no restriction to unaided models, so including an LLM paired with an evaluator is fair.

evidence.note: The prepublication peer-reviewed abstract reports new cap-set constructions from an evolutionary procedure pairing an LLM with an evaluator. It supports novelty from that system, not unaided model performance.

reviews.rationale: FunSearch reports mathematical constructions exceeding previously known results using LLM-generated programs and systematic evaluation. That contradicts the broad repetition-only restriction on the contract's fair ordinary reading. The packet does not establish unaided discovery, but the speaker did not impose that narrower scope.
